clog.text: Kimo-31 spoke of a dome at the meeting in the habitat: a roof of sky, and streets without suits.
The council is divided over the dome. Kith-49 speaks for building it, driven as ever; Fenka-16 says not yet, steady as ever.
The council has set the dome aside. While the ice runs short, no one has the heart for it.
Duvi-83 raised the dome again at the meeting in the habitat.
The council is divided over the dome. Fensk-17 speaks for building it, as their friends do; Quone-44 says not yet, steady as ever.
The council has set the dome aside for now. Quone-44 spoke for waiting, and many agreed.
